decision: Keep strict array/object descriptor inspection; no new trusted-input API or compiler bypass.
Encode Unicode-validated strings without a copying escape operation when they contain no JSON escape characters; C0, quotes and backslashes use native JSON.stringify.
Bounded per-walk token hits also prove this exact primitive string was validated; omitted/validation-only values still validate. Long prose never enters the pool.
Replace per-eviction Map iterators with a cleared1024-slot ring; retain existing1024-entry/131072-unit pool bounds.
Use native WASM hex output and a256-byte lookup for fallback digests; preserve independently owned states, terminal errors and reset.
counterexamples: C0/control/quote/backslash and full Unicode wire equivalence
Long Unicode at UTF-8 chunk boundaries
Multiple FIFO capacity/byte-budget wraps with repeated and distinct prefixes
Omitted/mismatching invalid Unicode, non-invoked accessors and sparse arrays
Nine interleaved binary/hex sinks exceed four WASM states; terminal/release behavior
